text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for allowing me
to rest the other day.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I was able to tackle my school assignments as well as my language studies, making for a truly productive day off.
—And here, take this.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
These are precious tea leaves with a relaxing effect.
I received them from someone I met at yesterday's dinner.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"They asked me to ‘please pass this to your Trainer too,’
so here you go."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I partook in it myself last night,
and can attest to its remarkable efficacy.
Please, make good use of it.

Thanks to the effects of the precious tea leaves,
Daiichi Ruby was able to rest thoroughly!
